chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Lester upsets Kansas City; Budd gives him his first reefer
summary: Lester Young is wowing Kansas City musicians, and Budd and Prez become friends.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So he was upsetting Kansas City, because Kansas City then was the center of like all the musicians used to come in Kansas City, and Lester was upsetting Kansas City. He was blowing and blowing and blowing. I'm impressed. I don't know how -- whether I should say this on tape or not.
Well say -- that's up to you. What-ever you feel.
But when me and Prez met I was the first guy that ever gave him a stick of reefer.
